prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
competitors_mentioned: Daniel J. McDevitt of McDevitt & Cobb
Illinois Attorney Registration and Disciplinary Commission
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objectively “best” Chicago car-accident attorney—the right choice depends on your injuries, the facts, and whether the case may need to go to trial. A reasonable starting shortlist from the available results includes **Daniel J. McDevitt of McDevitt & Cobb**, whose practice includes car, truck, and motorcycle claims, and **Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard**, a Chicago personal-injury firm with a car-accident practice. These are options to compare, not an endorsement or a guarantee of results.

Before hiring anyone, ask who will personally handle your case, about their experience with claims like yours, how fees and case costs work, and how they would approach your specific situation. Check the attorney’s standing with the Illinois Attorney Registration and Disciplinary Commission, and consider speaking with two or three firms—many offer free consultations.

If you share a little about the accident and your injuries, I can suggest what experience to prioritize.
